title: Insane 120Hz display and lightning fast charging
text: The AMOLED screen is gorgeous with vibrant colors and stellar peak brightness under direct sunlight. Charges from 10% to 100% in under 25 minutes. Performance is butter smooth.

title: Overheats during gaming and drains battery
text: Phone gets uncomfortably hot after 15 minutes of Genshin Impact. Battery drains rapidly when using 5G and camera. Software has annoying bloatware apps.

title: Best camera smartphone hands down
text: Low light photography is magical. The telephoto zoom lens produces crisp portraits with natural bokeh. Build feels sturdy and premium in hand.

title: Buggy software update ruined battery life
text: Ever since the latest OS update, the phone suffers from UI lag and battery standby time dropped by half. Hope the development team releases a patch soon.

title: Great flagship alternative at fair price
text: Speed and responsiveness are on par with phones twice the price. Fingerprint sensor is fast and accurate. Highly recommend for productivity users.

title: Cracked screen on minor drop
text: Dropped from 2 feet onto carpet and the glass screen shattered. Extremely fragile build quality. Repair cost quoted by customer service is exorbitant.

title: Solid daily driver with all day battery
text: Easily gets me through 7 hours of screen-on time. Speakers are loud and clear with great stereo separation. User interface is clean and snappy.

title: Stuttering animations and slow camera shutter
text: Noticeable shutter lag means you miss moving subjects like pets or kids. Mediocre performance given the advertised specs. Underwhelmed.
